text: Customer Identity Verification (KYC) Policy Document ID: Policy_C17_kyc_policy Category: C17 — KYC & Identity Verification Department: Compliance Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Policy Statement Establishes the mandatory identity verification standards for new connections and periodic re-verification, in line with applicable telecom licensing and regulatory requirements. Purpose Ensures consistent, compliant, and customer-fair treatment across all channels and customer segments. Scope Applies to all prepaid, postpaid, and (where noted) enterprise customers, and to all NovaTel-authorised channels. Definitions **Customer** — any individual or entity holding an active NovaTel connection or account. **Working day** — a business day excluding weekends and public holidays. Eligibility Applies to customers with an active, KYC-verified account in good standing, subject to the rules and exceptions below. Rules Requests are processed per the documented standard timelines. Customers are notified of outcomes via their registered contact channel. Exceptions Enterprise/pooled accounts may follow their signed commercial agreement instead. Approval Requirements Exceptions to standard rules require documented supervisor or department-head approval before being applied. Responsibilities Compliance Requirements This policy is designed to align with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g. TRAI/DoT guidance) as general background context; it is not a substitute for legal advice. Audit Considerations All exceptions and manual overrides must be logged with justification for periodic audit review.
